name: grid
description: Invoke discovered operations locally or across venues. Load when work or data spans venues or no directly advertised tool fits.

content.inline:
## Grid workflow
Inspect an unfamiliar operation's schema and effects before starting it. For a remote venue, discover its catalog on that venue, starting with `v/info/adapters`; a local catalog does not establish what the remote offers.

Keep an execution ledger for delegated work: purpose, exact Job ID, hosting venue, and authentication mode. Keep local wrapper handles separate from destination handles. A wrapper completing can mean submission succeeded while the destination work is still running.

Resolve a bare venue label from the task or the caller; never invent a domain. A `did:key` identifies a venue but provides no network address. Use a supplied HTTP(S) address or routable DID.

For long work, obtain a handle and continue independent work. Collect each outcome before starting dependent work. Lost visibility or a timed-out wait does not justify resubmitting a potentially mutating operation.

Authentication and authorization are separate: a credential proves identity, while grants permit actions. An unavailable venue and a permission refusal do not establish that an operation is absent.
